Mint, create signature, slot, chain time, and creator are transaction-derived. This supports EB0.2C CANONICAL_CREATE_PROOF when the complete row is coherent; it does not mean PF_WS_CREATOR_VERIFIED.
semantic_classification.MANUAL_ATTESTATION: Human confirmation without an automated signature chain. It may establish registry membership but cannot by itself establish EB0.2C canonical create proof or PF websocket identity.
semantic_classification.POST_MIG_BACKFILL+BACKFILL: Post-migration lineage reconstruction may choose COALESCE(earliest_tx_creator,pf_ws_creator), stores no create signature, and uses migrated_at as create_time. It is prohibited as canonical create/birth or qualified creator identity evidence.
semantic_classification.WALKBACK_RECOVERED+WALKBACK: Promoted from a CANONICAL_OPERATOR_REACHED walkback outcome. Creator may come from outcome/queue evidence, create signature may be absent, and create time may fall back to token_analysis.created_at or completion time. It does not independently prove canonical birth/create or PF websocket identity.
